title: Refining Spirit Stones
titles: A Primer on Spirit Stone Refinement
text:
External cultivators can place spirit stones in the cultivation menu's refinement slot.


Each five-second cycle consumes one stone and supplies 5 cultivation progress and 50 Qi, up to the cultivator's current limits.


The stone floats before the cultivator while its Qi flows into their chest. A stack is refined one stone at a time, even after closing the menu.


Refinement pauses without consuming stones when both cultivation progress and stored Qi are full.


A full cultivation-progress bar does not prevent refining another stone when you still need Qi.
